comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: The monsoon in southern Oman is something I’d love to witness in person. It’s hard to picture green hills and misty mountains in a country many people associate only with sand and heat. What interests me most, though, is how Omani families experience this season and how it shapes their traditions, work, and everyday lives.

comments.text: Three months of rain in a desert sounds impossible. Oman is one of those places that completely changes what you think desert life looks like. I would love to experience this side of the country for myself.
